description: Read how each of Yutai's data sources stands today, with a plain sentence for its mode, beside the answer's version, the build and its instant.
name: get_status

asOf.description: The instant this domain's age is judged from: its newest stored live record, or for the chain the oldest live chain's newest health reading, in ISO 8601 form; null when no record stands. A domain with no record reads ok: the freshness rule judges a record, never its absence.

status.description: ok when the domain's newest record stands inside its freshness window, degraded when a live domain's newest record stands past it.

asOf.description: The instant the newest accepted live price was published, in ISO 8601 form, or null when no accepted price stands.

stale.description: Whether the newest accepted live price is older than the 5-minute freshness window (aged at the last close while the market is closed), or no accepted price stands.

status.description: How the service stands: ok when it answers, degraded when part of it is unavailable, down when a check failed; a down word stands up to thirty seconds, so a recovered service can answer down briefly.

time.description: The instant this answer was made, in the ISO 8601 form.

version.description: The build this answer comes from: the first seven characters of the source commit, or unknown when the serving environment names none.

title: Get status
